Who I am

Building quality in, not testing bugs out

I'm a Software Engineering undergraduate at Sri Lanka Technology Campus with a strong interest in Quality Assurance, Test Automation, and Website Development. Through academic and personal projects I've worked across Software Requirements Specification (SRS), UML modeling, BDD/Gherkin, EARS, black-box testing, and risk analysis.

Skilled in Python, Java, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS — with a strong foundation in functional testing, defect reporting, and end-to-end web development.

Selected work

01 / Explainable AI

Explainable AI Loan Approval System

Developing a human-centered explainable AI framework for transparent, fair loan approval, focused on consumer microloans in developing-country contexts. Training XGBoost and Random Forest models on South Asian credit data, using SHAP and DiCE counterfactuals for human-readable explanations and AIF360 to evaluate and mitigate bias. Building a full-stack app with a Flutter front end and Node.js/Express API, containerized with Docker and deployed with Terraform on AWS.

PythonXGBoostSHAPDiCEAIF360FlutterNode.jsDockerTerraform
02 / Machine Learning

SmartCare: AI-Based Disease Risk Classification

Built a machine learning pipeline for hospital disease-risk classification using Logistic Regression, Random Forest and XGBoost, with SHAP for explainability. Found a fairness gap in risk coverage across age groups through subgroup analysis, deployed a live Streamlit prototype, and contributed to the technical report as part of a four-member team.

PythonScikit-learnXGBoostSHAPStreamlit

Node Classification on OGBN-Arxiv with Graph Neural Networks

Developed and evaluated Graph Convolutional Network (GCN) and Graph Attention Network (GAT) models for node classification on the OGBN-Arxiv citation dataset, with GPU training in Google Colab. Resolved framework compatibility issues and compared both architectures through hyperparameter tuning and evaluation metrics.
